notes.title: Patch Notes for the Demo
notes.content: [h3]Patch Notes[/h3][hr][/hr][list][*][p]Added new scene content for the school.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Steam configuration[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the calculation order for [b]skill hit rates[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Revised the text description for pets skipping turns.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the target calculation logic for [b]abnormal status skills[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the text broadcast sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new [b]Fantamon[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue with [b]abnormal status effect probabilities[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the prefab for stair tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the activation logic for [b]time scaling[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added an [b]all-nighter penalty[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where already harvested items on the farm would reappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue preventing sustainable harvesting when out of stamina.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the custom color and name process during [b]character creation[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added new [b]NPCs[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We are still improving the demo, hope you like it![/p][p][/p][p]Play the demo down there.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743470/Fantamon_Definitive_Edition/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743470/Fantamon_Definitive_Edition/[/url][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="IFSeCmaQ2w0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Disclaimer: All the assets here were all developed by the team that developed Fantamon since 2022, all rights reserved.[/p]
